artworks.title: Vignette for the Title Page of C. Peregrino, Principes Hollandiae et Zelandiae
artworks.artist: Christoffel Jegher after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper [proof]
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring animals and helmets arranged in a symbolic composition. In the center, there's a medallion with a hen on a nest above crossed staffs. On either side are helmeted profiles with banners above them; to the left, it reads “NOCTV” with an owl, and to the right, “DIVOYE” with a crowing cock. Above the medallion is a flaming lamp with the word “INCVBANDO” on a ribbon. The style is detailed with engravings and intricate line work reminiscent of classical and renaissance art.

artworks.title: Vignette for Title Page of Balthasar Cordier, Catena Patrum Graecorum in Sanctum Ioannem
artworks.artist: Cornelis Galle I after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper [proof]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate heraldic crest. The image features a coat of arms with two bird-like creatures flanking a shield topped with a crown. The shield displays various heraldic symbols, including a pattern of alternating colors, lions, and other traditional elements. Surrounding the shield are decorative elements such as laurels, floral designs, and cornucopias. Above the shield is a star or sun burst. The composition is symmetrical and detailed, conveying a sense of regality and artistry.

artworks.title: Printer's Device for the Plantin Press
artworks.artist: Christoffel Jegher after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: woodcut in red on laid paper [proof]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical style emblem or crest. The drawing features a central circular medallion depicting a figure framed by an ornate border. The surrounding design incorporates classical architectural elements and decorative motifs, including ornamental scrolls and floral accents. Two robed figures stand on either side of the central medallion, adding a sense of symmetry and balance to the composition. The artwork has a delicate and detailed linework, executed in a reddish tint.

artworks.title: Franz Rose in His Study
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows an older man seated on a sofa or chair. He has his legs crossed and a blanket draped over them. The man is holding a pipe in his right hand and is dressed in a formal military-style jacket. He has a mustache and neat, combed-back hair. Beside him is an ornate lamp on a stack of books, with more books visible on the right. The background features a densely textured wall with books or wooden panels.

artworks.title: Bedouin Women
artworks.medium: charcoal on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in draped garments covering their entire bodies, including their heads. Both figures are standing, with one figure having arms down and the other with an arm raised near the face area, holding onto the garment. The facial features and hair are not visible due to the coverage of the draped fabric. The fabric is flowing and gathered, creating a draping effect. There are no visible jewelry or objects aside from the fabric. The background is plain and unadorned.

artworks.title: Study of Ezekiel for "Frieze of Prophets"
artworks.medium: charcoal and white chalk on gray laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a standing person with flowing garments covering their body. The person's face is partially hidden by fabric or a hood, with the features not clearly defined. The clothing is large and flowing, creating a sense of movement and depth with light and shadow. There are no visible accessories or objects, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Study for "The Crucifixion and Death of Our Lord"
artworks.medium: charcoal on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image features a rough sketch of a person's upper body, from the shoulders up. The person appears to be sitting or leaning slightly forward. The facial features are implied with some shading around the eye area and a hint of a nose. The hair is sketched abstractly, showing a short hairstyle. The clothing is suggested by broad strokes around the shoulders, possibly a cloak or blanket. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain, with the main focus on the sketched figure.

artworks.title: Study for "Hell"
artworks.medium: charcoal and graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)

artworks.title: Quai de l'Hôtel de Ville
artworks.medium: wood engraving in black on tissue paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Eric Denker in memory of Gaillard F. Ravenel
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view across a wide expanse towards a large building, possibly a cathedral. The horizon sits just below the buildings. Architectural elements are detailed with intricate linework, capturing the texture and form of the structures. The color palette is subdued and monochromatic, using shades of grey and sepia to convey a wintry mood, with a dusting of snow. People are shown walking along a snow-covered street in the foreground. In the distance, the building dominates the skyline. Soft clouds are visible in the lightly rendered sky.

artworks.title: Henri de Bourbon, Roi de Navarre
artworks.artist: Simon Charles Miger after François-André Vincent
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on China paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 21.6 x 14.6 cm (8 1/2 x 5 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a detailed black and white engraving showing a half-length portrait of a man. The portrait is encased within an ornate oval frame adorned with leaves and intricate patterns. The man is seated and turned slightly to his right, gazing off into the distance. He possesses distinct facial features with a prominent nose and curly hair that flows and appears voluminous. He is wearing period clothing consisting of a dark, textured garment and a large, pleated ruff around his neck. Around him, within the frame, are items associated with power or military leadership, including a helmet with an ornate design, a decorative sword, and a map labeled with "Armee des Princes" and "Armee Royale." The background is filled with detailed engravings of foliage and scrollwork, adding texture and depth to the image.

artworks.title: Calais Pier
artworks.artist: Francis Seymour Haden after Joseph Mallord William Turner
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in brown on wove paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 49.4 x 61.4 cm (19 7/16 x 24 3/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth Fine and Larry Day in memory of Gaillard F. Ravenel
artworks.description: The image displays sailboats navigating through choppy waters. The horizon is high in the composition, framing the sails against the sky. The boats have intricate line work suggesting movement and texture of the sea. The style uses detailed lines akin to an etching technique, providing clarity and motion. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of brown, enhancing the atmosphere. In the distance, the water moves gently, giving depth to the scene.

artworks.title: An Elegant Hunting Party Resting by a Fountain
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch depicting a scene with a low horizon line, including trees, a statue on a pedestal, and figures engaging in activities. The sketch has a monochromatic color palette with quick pencil strokes suggesting motion and activity.

artworks.title: Wilhelm Trübner
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Toni G. Marcy in honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a man's bust, featuring his head and shoulders. The man is slightly turned to his left, with his face in three-quarter view. His facial features are emphasized with shadows around his eyes, nose, and mouth, and he has short, dark hair. The sketch does not depict detailed clothing. The background is plain with some handwritten text beside and below the man's face, as well as diagonal lines on the left.

artworks.title: Tiergarten (Zoological Garden)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Toni G. Marcy in honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: The image shows a low point of view looking through a lightly wooded area. The horizon is high with a collection of crosshatched lines representing tree trunks, branches, and foliage. The brushwork features energetic, hatched, and crisscrossed lines creating a textured representation of a woodland setting. The color palette is monochromatic, with various shades of black and white creating contrast and highlighting the outlines of the trees and underbrush. Nearest to us, lines imply undergrowth or grasses, while in the distance, the etching becomes denser and darker, suggesting depth and mature trees.

artworks.title: Frauenräuber (Rape)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Toni G. Marcy in honor of Christopher With
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rider on horseback alongside two figures. The image is executed with loose, expressive black lines that depict a horse with a figure atop it, while two other figures accompany the horse from the side. The drawing uses a series of quick, dynamic strokes to suggest movement and energy around the figures, giving a sketch-like impression rich in motion and drama. The scene captures a sense of interaction and focuses on conveying an emotional or narrative moment through the dynamic interplay of forms and lines.

artworks.title: Lake Nemi
artworks.medium: etching with monoprint inking on Chinese paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape seen from a low and distant point of view. The horizon divides the scene, with a faint line of light separating the darker silhouettes above and below. On the horizon, there is a slightly elevated landform, potentially a hill or mountain, with a subtle vertical element. Closest to the viewer on the left are silhouetted trees, blending into the dark tones of the surroundings. The brushstrokes are scratchy and textural, creating a sense of movement as lines weave horizontally. The color palette is monochromatic, mainly in shades of black, gray, and hints of lighter areas suggesting light.

artworks.title: Diogenes Searching for an Honest Man
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 21.2 x 30.2 cm (8 3/8 x 11 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: A bearded man in a robe stands to the left, leaning forward with a tool in his right hand, examining an assemblage of objects including a large skull in the right foreground. Two animals sit facing the man to the right. Behind them is a landscape with trees and distant hills. The color palette is primarily in shades of sepia. The scene looks aged and classical. Detailed textures are present throughout the composition.

artworks.title: Head of a Young Woman Wearing a Cap
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in red ink
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 46.5 x 34.6 cm (18 5/16 x 13 5/8 in.)
overall (outside framing line): 42.7 x 31.9 cm (16 13/16 x 12 9/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ivan E. and Winifred Phillips
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length sketch of a woman in profile, turned slightly to the right. The woman has soft shading on her facial features, with pronounced eyes and a slightly upturned nose. She wears a bonnet with curly hair peeking out and draped fabric around her shoulders. The background consists of cross-hatching lines.

artworks.title: Wilderness Landscape with Two Monks
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a scene of towering trees with textured trunks and leafy branches. The view is from a slightly elevated point, obscuring the horizon with dense foliage and a hilly landscape in the distance. The sky is filled with fluffy clouds depicted with hatching lines. The art style features intricate etching work creating detailed textures and shading with a monochromatic palette of black, gray, and white. Two figures are visible, one leaning against a tree and another seated by a stump near a thatched structure partly seen behind the trees. Rolling hills in the distance add depth to the scene.

artworks.title: David Playing the Harp before Saul
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from 4 blocks: black line block and three tone blocks in shades of gray-green on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of an interior scene. In the center, an older bearded man is seated on an ornate chair with other figures around him in various states of agitation and action. A musician is holding a lyre. A small animal, likely a dog, is at the central figure's feet. The figures are dressed in ancient or classical garments. The expressions on the faces are intense. The background contains pillars and a patterned window.

artworks.title: Indifferent (L'Indifférent)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 27.6 x 18.6 cm (10 7/8 x 7 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a mid-step position. The individual is detailed with one arm extended to the side holding an object, and the other arm stretched out. The person's facial features are clear, with detailed hair under a feathered hat. The person wears a period-style outfit with decorative elements. The background includes trees on the right and a grand building with a dome and spire in the distance. The sky has clouds.

artworks.title: Abandoned Park
artworks.medium: etching on light blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows tall trees on the left side reaching towards a cloud-filled sky. The horizon is located in the upper third. In the distance, a line of trees and a structure resembling a staircase or embankment are visible. Small figures are on the steps. The brushwork appears detailed and precise, likely etching. The color palette is monochromatic, using black and white shades.

artworks.title: Capriccio with Antique Ruins
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink, brush and gray ink, and gray wash over black chalk, heightened with white on brown wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of a scene with a stone structure, a distant classical building, a figure with tools, and a tree. The brushstrokes are loose, creating a sketch-like quality. The color palette is primarily earthy tones with some lighter highlights.

artworks.title: Two Scouts
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Edmund Louis Gray Zalinski, II
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of two men mounted on horses. Both men are seated upright and visible from the waist up. The man on the left wears a wide-brimmed hat and a mustache, while the man on the right wears a side cap and a clean-shaven face. They both wear military-style uniforms with double-breasted coats. The sketch is set against a plain background with faint outlines suggesting terrain, and there are handwritten notes at the bottom of the image.
